output_list.reason: The function buyHeart() is designed to buy Heart. The value of _hearts is calculated by dividing msg.value by Heart price. However, the Heart price is calculated by (RoundHeart[Round].add(1000000000000000000)).ethRec(1000000000000000000), which may lead to integer overflow if the Heart price is very low. The attacker can send very small value of msg.value to buy lots of Heart. The attacker will lose all the value sent by him/her.
